verdict.rationale: EBANX docs describe an API Reference that lets you fill or pre-fill card and payment fields and send the request directly from the reference page. Sandbox test cards come as ready-to-use objects with expected responses, so examples can be run against the sandbox. The OpenAPI probe 404s only mean no spec file sits at the common paths; that does not contradict the interactive reference. missing for 10: evidence that the try-it console covers the full API beyond pay-in card flows, details on code-sample languages, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
